items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: I went to Berklee... I had my teacher’s gig. J. Ray Santisi’s gig. And when I was going to that school in Copley Square I took a couple of lessons with Ray

ctx.x: Well you know, as I went through the scene you know I have to digress for a minute so you pull me back. I’m doing a lot of legacy work now with digitizing a lot of bootleg records. And I have my career, my musical growth, from 1962 up through the 90s, digitized. Maybe even more than that. And I thought it took me a much longer time to get my stuff together in Boston. I went to Berklee and started in ’56, ’57, went through the summer of ’57, left in ’58. By ’62 I had all the best gigs in town. I thought it took me…
